triggers.name: customer_usage_threshold_reached
triggers.title: Usage threshold reached
triggers.description: Triggers when usage thresholds are reached in 10% intervals
triggers.help: This trigger monitors all workspaces and triggers when a workspace reaches thresholds of their usage limits for tasks according to their plan. Receive an event for every 10% of usage. For OEM admin accounts, this trigger monitors all customers’ workspaces.

triggers.name: deployment_finished

triggers.description: Deployment completed

triggers.name: fanbus_apim_api_request_timeout
triggers.title: API request timeout
triggers.description: API request exceeded timeout limit
triggers.help: This trigger monitors the API request runtime for all endpoints in the workspace. Triggers when an API request exceeds the timeout limit of N seconds.

triggers.name: fanbus_apim_concurrency_limit_reached
triggers.title: API concurrency threshold exceeded
triggers.description: API concurrency threshold exceeded in workspace
triggers.help: This trigger monitors API concurrency usage for the workspace. Triggers when API requests exceed 80% of the API concurrency limit.

triggers.name: fanbus_apim_quota_threshold_reached
triggers.title: API policy quota violations
triggers.description: This trigger monitors API usage for the workspace. Triggers when a client exceeds policy usage quotas.
triggers.help: This trigger monitors usage for all clients with an API policy. Triggers when a client’s API traffic reaches policy quotas.

triggers.name: fanbus_apim_rate_limit_reached
triggers.title: API policy rate limit violations
triggers.description: This trigger monitors API usage for the workspace. Triggers when a client exceeds policy rate limits.
triggers.help: This trigger monitors usage for all clients with an API policy. Triggers when a client’s API traffic violates policy rate limits.

triggers.name: fanbus_opa_disconnected
triggers.title: On-prem agent disconnected
triggers.description: On-prem agent disconnected
triggers.help: This will monitor all your on-prem agent(s) in the selected on-prem group. If an agent has been disconnected from Workato and fails to reconnect, a trigger event will be created. This trigger aggregates disconnect events for a specific time frame to reduce noise. It is available starting from on-pre…

input.name: gateway_tunnel
input.label: On-prem group to monitor
input.hint: Select one on-prem group to monitor

triggers.name: job_error
triggers.title: Job failed
triggers.description: Receive notification when a job fails in specified recipes
triggers.help: This trigger monitors failed jobs in specified recipes. It triggers when a monitored recipe encounters a job failure.

triggers.name: shared_account_refresh_failed
triggers.title: Account credentials refresh failed
triggers.description: Receive notification when an App fails to refresh its access credentials
triggers.help: This trigger monitors only OAuth and Multi-digest connections and creates a job if the specified connections fail to refresh its access credentials. Connections that utilise Basic, API key or similar static API credentials are excluded since there are no API credentials refresh mechanisms.

triggers.description: Receive notification when a recipe is stopped due to errors
triggers.help: This trigger monitors recipes stopped by Workato as a result of errors.

actions.name: get_recipe
actions.title: Get recipe details
actions.description: Get recipe details of specified recipe
actions.help: Retrieve information about the recipe such as recipe name, number of successful jobs and failed jobs etc. Lifetime task count has task data starting from March 19, 2021.

actions.name: list_jobs
actions.title: Search job history
actions.description: Search job history of specified recipe
actions.help: Jobs can be filtered by status and start time. Results list is limited to a maximum of 1000 jobs.

input.name: status
input.label: Job status
input.hint: Fetch job records with selected status

input.name: started_at_from
input.label: Jobs created since
input.hint: Fetch job records created since the given date. Defaults to including records since the beginning if left blank.

input.name: started_at_to
input.label: Jobs created till
input.hint: Fetch job records created till the given date. Defaults to including the records till now (time when action is carried out) if left blank.

actions.name: search_connections
actions.title: List connections
actions.help: Connections can be filtered by name, recipe and applications. Search for runtime user connections by external ID or parent-child connection relationships. Results are limited to 1000 connections ordered by most recently updated.

input.name: name
input.label: Connection name
input.hint: Provide complete connection name. Search is case sensitive.

input.name: provider
input.label: Application
input.hint: Retrieve all connections of the selected app.

input.name: parent_connection_id
input.label: Parent connection name
input.hint: Select a parent connection or enter the connection ID.

input.name: child_connections
input.label: Search for child connections
input.hint: To search for child connections, provide the connection name and parent connection.

input.name: external_id
input.label: External ID
input.hint: Search for connections created with an external ID.

actions.name: search_recipes
actions.title: List recipes
actions.help: Recipes can be filtered by statuses and IDs. A maximum of 1000 recently updated recipes can be returned. Lifetime task count has task data starting from March 19, 2021.

input.name: status
input.label: Recipe status
input.hint: Select the status of recipes to retrieve

input.name: recipe_id
input.label: Recipe IDs
input.hint: One or more recipe IDs separated by commas. The recipe ID is the number found after www.workato.com/recipes/ in the recipe URL, e.g. if the recipe URL is workato.com/recipes/362905-timekeeper , then r…

actions.name: search_recipes_v2
actions.title: Search recipes
actions.help: Recipes can be filtered by statuses and connection name/ID. A maximum of 1000 recently updated recipes can be returned. Lifetime task count has task data starting from March 19, 2021.

input.name: status
input.label: Recipe status
input.hint: Select the status of recipes to retrieve

actions.name: start_recipe
actions.title: Start recipe
actions.help: Starts specified recipe. Job fails with error if recipe can not be started, e.g. when recipe apps are not connected.

actions.name: stop_recipe
actions.title: Stop recipe
actions.help: Stops specified recipe. When a recipe with pending job(s) is stopped, these jobs are paused until the recipe is started again.

input.name: force_stop
input.label: Force stop
input.hint: Use Yes or true if you want to stop recipes with pending jobs, No or false otherwise.

actions.name: summary_status
actions.title: Get account details
actions.help: Get account details like plan, transactions used, recipe counts, etc.
